items.title: Tiger Brokers Singapore Brings Extended-Hours US Options Trading to Singapore Investors
items.summary: Tiger Brokers (Singapore) Pte Ltd ("Tiger Brokers Singapore"), an online brokerage licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), will offer extended-hours US options trading on its Tiger Trade platform from 9 November 2026. Clients will be able to trade options on selected US stocks before the US market opens and shortly after it closes, through Tiger Brokers Singapore's partnership with Cboe Global Markets, which introduced the new sessions on 19 October.
